observed_anchors: Target main #504 records exact-head self-hosted success for launcher syntax, inherited pre-guard regression, imported-guard-chain regression, static integrity, evidence upload and cleanup.
Target main explicitly keeps productive root-anchor/service/runtime/restart/recovery evidence open.
Current V5 launcher begins with #!/bin/sh and explicitly states that an upstream trusted launcher/service must establish the executable/environment boundary before /bin/sh executes.
Open draft PR #484 binds systemd executable path, ExecStartEx flags and structured argv semantics, but remains stale/non-promotable and does not explicitly bind the script interpreter identity.
hypothesis: For a script-based ProductStart, binding launcher bytes/hash plus systemd executable path and argv is insufficient to uniquely bind the first executable code image unless the shebang interpreter chain is also deployment-attested.
strongest_counterhypothesis: If the accepted deployment immutably and independently attests /bin/sh and its resolved executable identity across start, restart and rollback, then an additional runtime interpreter identity field is redundant rather than release-critical.

live_external_evidence.claim_used: An executable script beginning with #!interpreter causes the named interpreter to be invoked with the script path and arguments; interpreter identity is therefore a distinct execution layer.
ExecStart records expose an executable path plus the argv vector and runtime metadata, supporting explicit ProductStart tuple observation rather than treating argv as incidental text.

go_oob_experiment.procedure: Create one executable #!/bin/sh probe once, hash it, execute the same unchanged bytes directly through kernel/shebang dispatch, then execute the same bytes explicitly with /bin/bash; record /proc/$$/exe and hash again; cleanup temp tree.

baseline.execution: direct executable script / kernel shebang dispatch

intervention.execution: explicit /bin/bash over the identical script bytes

go_oob_experiment.falsified_reality: A trusted launcher script hash by itself uniquely identifies the first executable code image.
go_oob_experiment.epistemic_limit: This is a mechanism discriminator only. It does not prove the accepted Hostinger VPS currently starts Frank through the wrong interpreter or that an attacker can alter the productive interpreter.

grf_collapse.preferred_reality: ProductStart admission should bind the actual script interpreter chain in addition to launcher/argv/release/runtime/state identities.

required_observations: ExecStart/ExecStartEx executable, flags and full argv
script shebang interpreter pathname and resolved path chain
root-owned non-group-or-other-writable interpreter path plus strong artifact/build identity under deployment policy
launcher/guard release-bundle identities and root anchor

architecture_test_delta.negative_control: A deterministic fixture may keep launcher bytes constant while changing interpreter identity; ProductStart admission must fail closed. This ordinary regression is a follow-up test obligation, not a second unusual experiment.
